prompts.title: The Weight of Thought
prompts.prompt:
Create a striking, ultra-detailed, high-contrast monochrome (black-and-white) portrait based on the uploaded reference image. The subject’s facial structure and identity must match the reference precisely — accurately replicate bone structure, eye shape, nose proportions, jawline definition, beard density (if present), hairline, and overall facial symmetry. Maintain authentic skin texture and natural features without artificial smoothing.
Subject & Expression
A mature, confident man with a strong facial structure and deep-set eyes looking directly into the camera. Expression should be serious, contemplative, and quietly authoritative. Preserve natural skin details such as pores, fine lines, and subtle texture for realism. The gaze should feel focused and introspective, not aggressive.
Facial Hair (Adaptive)
If facial hair is present in the reference image, replicate it exactly — density, length, shape, and edges. Maintain natural tonal variation (including salt-and-pepper graying if applicable). Beard lines should be clean and structured.

If clean-shaven, preserve realistic skin texture and jaw definition.
Hairstyle (Adaptive)
Match the hairstyle from the reference image exactly — volume, direction, hairline, and texture. Hair should look natural with visible strand detail and subtle specular highlights from overhead directional lighting.
Pose
Classic “thinker” pose. One hand raised to the chin with thumb along the jawline and index finger slightly curled. Knuckles and tendons subtly defined for realism. Hand in sharp focus with visible skin texture and natural tonal gradation.
🔥 Lighting & Technical Style (Accurately Customized)
Low-key fine-art studio photography with controlled high-contrast sculpting.
• Primary key light positioned slightly above eye level and slightly toward the viewer’s left, angled downward to create strong top-plane highlights.

• Light is soft but directional (large softbox or diffused beauty dish), producing crisp edge definition without harsh clipping.

• Strong highlight concentration on forehead center, nose bridge, upper cheekbones, beard texture, and the top planes of the hand.

• Subtle shadow shaping under the brow ridge and cheekbones to enhance bone structure.

• The shadow side of the face remains deep but not fully crushed — maintaining controlled midtone detail.

• Minimal fill light from front-center to retain facial symmetry while preserving depth.

• Very subtle rim separation along hair edges and outer shoulder to prevent blending into background.

• Catchlights centered and natural — small, soft rectangular reflection in both eyes.

• Background is fully black with zero visible texture, absorbing all spill light.
Contrast ratio should be high but refined — not blown highlights, not muddy blacks. Clean tonal roll-off.
Composition
Tight vertical head-and-shoulders crop (portrait orientation, 4:5 ratio recommended). Subject centered symmetrically for a formal, balanced presence. Background is pure crushed black with no visible texture.
Color & Tonality
Pure black and white conversion with neutral tonal balance (no color tint).

Wide dynamic range — deep true blacks, bright clean highlights, and smooth midtone transitions.

Micro-contrast enhancement to emphasize skin and beard texture.
Depth of Field
Shallow depth of field with razor-sharp focus on eyes and front hand. Slight softness toward ears and far shoulder.
Wardrobe
Dark black crewneck sweater or minimalist top with matte texture that absorbs light and blends into background. Subtle rim separation on shoulder edge.
Quality & Mood
Cinematic fine-art portrait. Ultra-realistic. Editorial studio quality. 8K resolution. Sharp micro-details. Mood: powerful, introspective, refined, quietly dominant.

prompts.title: Mood Board 2.0
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality square collage composed of six equal panels arranged in a 3×2 grid, featuring six stylized 3D caricature portraits. The collage layout should match a clean social-media style character collage, with evenly sized tiles aligned in a tight grid inside a 1:1 canvas.

Collage framing requirements:
Final image canvas aspect ratio 1:1
Six equal square panels
arranged in 3 columns × 2 rows
panels aligned edge-to-edge in a clean grid
no spacing between panels
Each tile fills its grid cell completely
character-centred in every tile
bold, solid-colour backgrounds per tile

The character must maintain strong facial identity consistency and accurate face matching across all six panels, preserving the same recognizable person while only changing expression, pose, outfit and minor accessories.

Face identity requirements:
consistent face shape and proportions
matching hairstyle, hairline, and hair texture
consistent skin tone and facial structure
same eye shape, nose shape, and lip structure
preserve defining facial features (jawline, cheekbones, eyebrows, etc.)
character must clearly look like the same person in every panel

Each portrait should closely match the following specific poses and expressions, using horizontal framing:
Panel 1 — Joyful / Celebratory
Arms raised, big open smile, energetic posture.
Panel 2 — Surprised / Shocked
Hands on cheeks, wide eyes, raised eyebrows, open mouth.
Panel 3 — Serious / Stern
Arms crossed, slightly furrowed brows, composed posture.
Panel 4 — Cute / Affectionate
Holding a small dog or cat close to the chest, with a soft smile.
Panel 5 — Sassy / Confident
One hand on hip, slight smirk, relaxed stance.
Panel 6 — Confident / Approving
Thumbs-up gesture, relaxed smile, optional hat accessory.

Each portrait features a different modern outfit, reflecting the subject's mood.

Style the character as a stylized 3D caricature with:
slightly exaggerated facial proportions
smooth rounded geometry
polished skin shading
soft subsurface scattering
collectable designer-toy aesthetic

Rendering and quality:
soft ambient studio lighting
gentle rim lighting
smooth shadows
glossy but realistic materials
4K ultra-high-resolution rendering
clean edges and high-detail textures

Backgrounds:
bold, vibrant, solid colors per tile (yellow, blue, red, pink, purple, green)
simple gradient or flat background
no environmental scene elements

Ensure:
consistent camera angle across all panels
waist-up framing
centered composition
modern animation-studio character quality
clean, minimal, professional collage presentation

prompts.title: Behind the Smile
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded photo as a strict identity reference. The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, jawline, lips, hairline, and hairstyle must remain identical.
This is one single subject (not two people, not two faces).

Only the style and emotion changes across the split.
No beautification. No reshaping. No stylization. No identity drift.
Main Concept
Create a 4:5 aspect ratio, ultra-realistic cinematic studio portrait with DSLR realism, 8K sharp detail, natural skin texture, soft focus, and shallow depth of field.
A conceptual duality portrait: public persona vs hidden emotion.
Composition & Framing
Vertical, centered portrait
Subject perfectly centered, facing forward, direct eye contact
One continuous face across the split
A jagged white torn-paper seam runs vertically down the exact center
Head-and-shoulders framing, subject fills most of the frame
Matte black studio background
Subject
A slender adult woman wearing a black turtleneck sweater.

Natural wavy hair with realistic texture and shine.
Left Side (Color) — Public Persona
Full color (ONLY left side)
Warm, glowing complexion
Vibrant red lipstick
Confident closed-mouth smile
Lighting: warm and flattering, highlights hair shine and skin glow
Right Side (Black & White) — Private Reality
Pure monochrome / black-and-white (ONLY right side)
Same exact face and hair (no duplication)
Somber, melancholic expression
Lips neutral, slightly parted
A single visible tear running down near the center seam
Lighting: soft but moody, more shadow depth under the eyes
Realism & Texture
Photorealistic DSLR look, visible pores, natural skin texture, no smoothing, no artificial glow.
Negative Prompt
No second subject

No duplicated face

No face morphing

No painting/illustration/anime/cartoon / 3D

No plastic skin

No over-softening
